title: It will rain today, you know!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It will rain today, you know!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But look — the sky is all blue right now.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I think I can smell the rain coming!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes! It smells like wet dirt. I think it's coming soon!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Hmm... those clouds ARE turning gray over there.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: See? It will rain — I told you!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then we'd better grab the umbrellas, weather tiger!
